skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and implement general business management functions including planning, organizing, monitoring, and controlling.
Identify research problems related to business management at internship sites.

Analyze and assess the current operations of organizations and businesses, including strategic evaluation, production activities, business development, innovation, productivity improvement, project management, decision-making, business performance assessment, sustainable business practices, etc.
Analyze the economic and technological characteristics of businesses.

Understand and apply methods for strategic planning, building corporate culture, leadership, business planning, organization and operation, control and evaluation, business activity improvement, project management, report writing, etc.
Collect and process information using various methods for analysis and research.
Develop problem-solving skills and propose solutions to issues identified through analysis and evaluation.
Gain understanding of laws and regulations, comply with unit rules, adapt to working conditions.
